privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how ShifoPath India may collect and use information submitted through this website.

information.title: Information We Collect
information.text: We may collect information such as your name, country, phone number, email address, service requirement and message when you submit an enquiry.

use.title: How We Use Information
use.text: Information may be used to respond to enquiries, coordinate requested services and communicate with you about your requirements.

medical.title: Medical Information
medical.text: If medical documents are requested or shared, they should only be provided when necessary for coordination or consultation purposes. Please avoid sharing unnecessary sensitive information.

security.title: Data Security
security.text: We take reasonable steps to protect information handled through the website, but no online system can guarantee absolute security.

contact.title: Contact
contact.text: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact ShifoPath India.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: By using this website, you agree to the following general terms and conditions.

information.title: Website Information
information.text: Information provided on this website is for general informational and coordination purposes.

services.title: Coordination Services
services.text: ShifoPath India may assist with coordination of appointments, accommodation, transport, interpretation and patient support services.

healthcare.title: Healthcare Decisions
healthcare.text: Medical diagnosis, treatment decisions and clinical care are the responsibility of qualified healthcare professionals and healthcare providers.

accuracy.title: Information Accuracy
accuracy.text: We aim to keep information useful and accurate, but hospital services, doctor availability, prices and other details may change.

contact.title: Contact
contact.text: For questions regarding these terms, please contact ShifoPath India.

medicalDisclaimer.title: Medical Disclaimer
medicalDisclaimer.intro: The information on this website is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis or treatment.

notMedicalAdvice.title: Not Medical Advice
notMedicalAdvice.text: ShifoPath India provides medical travel coordination and support information. We do not provide medical diagnosis or treatment through this website.

professionals.title: Healthcare Professionals
professionals.text: Medical decisions should be made directly with qualified doctors and healthcare providers.

emergency.title: Medical Emergencies
emergency.text: If you are experiencing a medical emergency, contact your local emergency service or seek immediate medical attention.

information.title: Information Changes
information.text: Hospital services, doctor availability, treatment options and costs may change. Confirm current information directly with the relevant healthcare provider.
